target.title: test: prove native command session targeting in QA Lab
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `native-command-session-target` QA scenario linked a harness-heavy Vitest file, so its primary maturity evidence did not prove that a native channel command could interrupt a real active routed conversation through QA Lab.

## Why This Change Was Made

This replaces the link with a real QA Channel flow. Native command metadata now travels through the QA bus and the shared transport action, QA Channel derives the normal separate slash-command session while retaining the routed conversation as `CommandTargetSessionKey`, and native control commands can bypass an active ordered turn without reordering ordinary inbound messages.

The deterministic mock provider exposes current in-flight requests so the scenario proves the target turn is active before sending `/stop`. No taxonomy or coverage IDs are added.

## User Impact

QA maturity evidence now gives honest primary coverage for the existing `channels.native-command-session-target` ID. `channels.native-commands` remains secondary coverage.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qa-channel/src/gateway.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/providers/mock-openai/server.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/scenario-catalog.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/suite-planning.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/suite-runtime-flow.test.ts extensions/qa-channel/src/inbound.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/qa-channel-transport.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/scenario-flow-runner.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/scenario-runtime-api.test.ts`
  - 9 files, 201 tests passed.
- `pnpm openclaw qa suite --provider-mode mock-openai --scenario native-command-session-target --concurrency 1 --fast`
  - Passed with `native command reply=Agent was aborted; recovery reply=QA-NATIVE-STOP-RECOVERY-OK`.
- Testbox-through-Crabbox `pnpm check:changed`
  - Provider: `blacksmith-testbox`
  - ID: `tbx_01kwfm2c2ffg0zm60br2b924gy`
  - Passed typecheck, lint, import-cycle checks, and repository guards.
  - Run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28543973404
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --engine codex`
  - Clean: no accepted/actionable findings.
